== Summary ==
Original slip, 17 July 2004: Bane Malar (V), as printed on the Players Committee's 17 July 2004 sheet for [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]].

'''Old pre-template slip''' (before the Committee's December 2006 Remaster template).

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040730074404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf Virtual Set #7 first release sheet] (Players Committee; PDF dated 17 July 2004; VirtualCards7.pdf on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 30 July 2004), page 1, slip 12. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip (with its printed label above it) cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Bane Malar (V) (Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire) (Original)|Bane Malar (V) (Virtual Set 7)]].
